name: seekers-rifle-class-bonus-spellshroud-ranger-champion-spell-cannot-target-it
notes: Seeker's Rifle: [Class Bonus] Spellshroud -- active (Class Bonus met: player 2's champion is a Ranger (Diana, Keen Huntress)). Seeker's Rifle (3gygojwk0p, REGALIA,WEAPON): "[Class Bonus] Spellshroud" (a conditional printed Spellshroud: the keyword only applies while the controller's champion class matches). HasSpellshroud() had no entry for it (hard-coded ID list only), so a spell could always target it. Fixed: HasSpellshroud() returns true for it when IsClassBonusActive() holds for its controller. Condition: Class Bonus met: player 2's champion is a Ranger (Diana, Keen Huntress). Player 2 controls the holder plus a Mirrordepth's Blade; player 1 plays Fracturize ("Target item or weapon becomes a Cleric Fractal phantasia ...", a Spell): the target prompt offers ONLY the Mirrordepth's Blade, the holder answer is refused (expectFailure) and the legal answer resolves.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Spellshroud: while the champion's class matches, the object can't be targeted by spells.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Seeker's Rifle's conditional printed [Class Bonus] Spellshroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (Data/ProcessKeywordsGA.php has no Spellshroud keyword, so function_exists is false), and 3gygojwk0p was in neither. Evidence on HEAD 48faaae9 (this fixture, run against the unfixed Custom/GameLogic.php): player 1's spell target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1&theirField-2' -- every holder was offered, and the first refused answer was accepted ('Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded'). Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for 3gygojwk0p while IsClassBonusActive() holds for its controller (a Ranger champion), after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates. Break/restore: reverting Custom/GameLogic.php to HEAD~1 (48faaae9) fails this fixture (Step 4 unexpectedly succeeded; this fixture requires rejection); restoring the fix (shasum 0ae48c678ba109f3cbd835f3b409cbd37d44a11c) passes. Full-suite revert: 22 of the 28 new fixtures fail (1011/1033), the 6 negative controls / pins pass either way. Paired with the negative control seekers-rifle-class-bonus-spellshroud-non-ranger-champion-spell-can-target-it (mutation check: dropping the IsClassBonusActive gate fails only that control, 1032/1033).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for 3gygojwk0p; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
